advancements.phantomism.discovery.root.d: Discover the phantoms of your world
screen.phantomism.staff.title: Manage Phantoms
screen.phantomism.staff.select_all_toolt: Select all of your nearby Phantoms for group commands. Abilities still require one selected Phantom.
screen.phantomism.staff.select_target: Right-click the target you want the Phantom to attack
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.follow: Follow you and roam nearby when you stop. Keeps the assigned activity.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.stay: Hold the current position instead of following you. Still responds to danger.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.guard: Follow and protect you, intercepting nearby hostile mobs.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.wander: Patrol the configured area around Home, defend it from nearby monsters, then return after combat. Without Home, roam locally. Keeps the assigned activity.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.attack_t: Select this, then right-click an enemy in sight up to 32 blocks away. Left-click to cancel selection.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.recall: Teleport your selected loaded phantoms near you and switch them to Follow Me. Does not return them Home.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.clear_ta: Stop attacking the current target and briefly suppress retaliation. Keeps movement and activity orders.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.guard_po: Select this, then right-click a solid block. Patrol that location, intercept nearby threats, and return after combat.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.set_home: Select this, then sneak-right-click a bed to assign Home. Sets a reference for wandering and activities without moving your phantoms.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.return_h: Fly to safe air near the assigned Home in this dimension, then stay there. Pauses the activity during travel without erasing it. Requires a Home.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.activity: Stop Harvest, Hunt, or Collect without changing movement. Any carried items are kept.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.harvest: Clear nearby short grass while keeping the movement order. Respects mob griefing and block protection; leaves crops and flowers alone.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.hunt: Automatically hunt nearby hostile mobs, not players, pets, or passive animals. Direct attack orders take priority.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.collect: Pick up nearby accessible dropped items and deliver them when you are close. Carries one stack at a time; keeps it if your inventory is full.
screen.phantomism.staff.select_home: Shift-right-click a bed to set Home; left-click to cancel
screen.phantomism.staff.select_guard: Right-click a solid block to guard it; left-click to cancel
message.phantomism.staff.invalid_positio: No safe guard position above that block
config.phantomism.phantom.tooltip: Home patrol size and automatic protection of same-owner companions.
config.phantomism.phantom.homeRadius.too: Horizontal distance in blocks from the assigned bed. Default: 200; allowed: 4-1000. Patrols and activities only use loaded chunks; existing saved values are kept.
config.phantomism.phantom.familyDefenseR: Nearby adults defend hurt same-owner pets from attackers within their awareness range. Does not take control from riders, replace active targets, or retaliate against owner/family hits or environmental damage. Default: 32; allowed: 4-64.

config.phantomism.blackPhantom.stats.max: Health points: 2 = 1 heart. Allowed: 1-1024. Raising the limit does not heal existing pets; lowering it clamps their current health.
config.phantomism.blackPhantom.stats.att: Base melee damage: 2 = 1 heart. Allowed: 0-2048. Ability bonuses stack separately; projectile and area damage stay unchanged.
config.phantomism.blackPhantom.stats.arm: Armor points used by Minecraft's damage reduction formula. 2 = 1 armor icon. Allowed: 0-30.
Reduces armor penetration from powerful hits. A vanilla diamond armor piece provides 2. Allowed: 0-20.

config.phantomism.blackPhantom.stats.fly: Scales autonomous flight and mounted horizontal movement, not vertical aiming controls. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Extreme speeds can make navigation less reliable.
config.phantomism.blackPhantom.stats.fol: Nearby-entity sensing and autonomous combat range in blocks, separate from Home patrol size. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. High values increase server work.

advancements.phantomism.discovery.sand_p: Discover a Sand Phantom surveying the desert dunes.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.tooltip: Patient desert ambusher. Immune to cactus damage, with modest heat resilience and faster low flight over desert sand. Not immune to lava.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.tool: Applies to adults, babies, wild and tamed phantoms. Existing loaded phantoms update within one second. Raising maximum health does not heal pets. Desert and diving bonuses are separate.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.maxH: Health points: 2 = 1 heart. Default: 36; allowed: 1-1024. Raising the limit does not heal existing pets; lowering it clamps their current health.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.atta: Base melee damage before armor. Default: 4; allowed: 0-2048. Sand Dive adds 5 damage to a prepared diving bite; Sand Bolt and Sandstorm are balanced separately.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.armo: Armor points used by Minecraft's damage reduction formula. Default: 3; allowed: 0-30. 2 points = 1 armor icon.
Reduces armor penetration from powerful hits. Default: 0; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.knoc: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.15; allowed: 0-1.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.move: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Flying near desert sand adds 15 percent without stacking repeatedly.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.flyi: Scales autonomous and mounted horizontal flight. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Low desert flight adds 15 percent. Mounted vertical controls remain unchanged.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.foll: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Guard's Sand Awareness watches threats within 24 blocks of the owner. Home patrol radius is separate.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.gold_p: Discover a rare Gold Phantom exploring the badlands or stony peaks.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.tooltip: Tactical treasure hunter with visible cave hints, blinding Gold Dust, Gold Rush, Golden Shield and a finishing Gold Eye. Gold Eye rewards at most 3 nuggets per owner per minute, only on its own hostile killing blow.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.tool: Applies to wild and tamed adults and babies. Loaded phantoms update within one second. Raising maximum health does not heal pets. Ability bonuses are separate.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.maxH: Health points: 2 = 1 heart. Default: 36; allowed: 1-1024. Raising the limit does not heal pets; lowering it clamps their health.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.atta: Base melee damage before armor. Default: 4; allowed: 0-2048. Gold Rush adds 5 damage to a prepared dive. Gold Dust and Gold Eye damage are balanced separately.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.armo: Armor points used by Minecraft's damage reduction formula. Default: 5; allowed: 0-30.
Reduces armor penetration from powerful hits. Default: 0; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.knoc: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.15; allowed: 0-1. Golden Shield adds a temporary 0.7 bonus.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.move: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Gold Rush uses the shared fast diving combat movement.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.flyi: Scales autonomous and mounted horizontal flight. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Mounted vertical aiming controls remain shared.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.foll: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Cave hints scan visible loaded openings within 25 blocks every five seconds, without moving toward them or revealing hidden ores.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.cherry: Discover a graceful Cherry Phantom among the blossoms of a Cherry Grove.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.tooltip: Gentle blossom guardian. She prioritizes healing and ranged support, with a delicate blossom crown, petal-patterned wings and protective sanctuary.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.to: Applies to wild and tamed adults and babies. Loaded phantoms update within one second. Raising maximum health does not heal pets. Support heals only her owner and same-owner companions; babies cannot cast combat abilities.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.ma: Health points: 2 = 1 heart. Default: 34; allowed: 1-1024. Raising the limit does not heal pets; lowering it clamps their health.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.at: Base close-range defensive bite damage. Default: 3; allowed: 0-2048. Petal Barrage and sanctuary pulses are balanced separately.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.ar: Armor points used by Minecraft's damage reduction formula. Default: 3; allowed: 0-30.
Reduces armor penetration from powerful hits. Default: 0; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.kn: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.1; allowed: 0-1. Sakura Veil grants temporary Resistance rather than changing this attribute.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.mo: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Cherry prefers a supportive ranged orbit to repeated dives.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.fl: Scales autonomous and mounted horizontal flight. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Her slower graceful wingbeats are cosmetic; mounted controls remain shared.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.fo: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Family support and Eternal Blossom are separately limited to 12 blocks and loaded, visible recipients.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.phanto: Discover a proud aerial guardian among the mountain peaks.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.tooltip: Durable aerial assault companion. Demon Horns, draconic dives, sustained breath and violet fireballs; 1.25x shared-model size, not a transformation.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.to: Loaded phantoms update within one second. Raising maximum health does not heal pets. Dragon Wings and Fury add temporary bonuses separately; babies cannot use combat abilities.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.ma: Health points: 2 = 1 heart. Default: 46; allowed: 1-1024. Raising the limit does not heal pets; lowering it clamps their health.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.at: Base melee damage. Default: 6; allowed: 0-2048. Draconic Dive adds 6; Strength and armor apply normally. Breath and fireball damage are balanced separately.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.ar: Armor points used by Minecraft's damage reduction formula. Default: 5; allowed: 0-30.
Reduces armor penetration from powerful hits. Default: 0; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.kn: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.2; allowed: 0-1. Dragon Wings adds 0.35 while adults are airborne, not swimming.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.mo: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Dragon's Fury temporarily increases it by 20%.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.fl: Autonomous and mounted horizontal flight speed. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Fury adds 20%; vertical controls remain shared.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.fo: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Breath, shockwaves and fireballs keep their own bounded ranges.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.violet: Discover an elegant violet duelist in a meadow or flower forest.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.tooltip: Precision aerial duelist. Successful Lance, Dive and Crosscut hits build distinct-move Momentum; Rupture spends it. Mounted G retains the shared 0.4-second cooldown.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.to: Adjust Violet's base attributes. Momentum, fixed projectile damage and ability cooldowns are separate. Defaults preserve the proposed 56 HP, 8 attack, 6 armor and 2 toughness baseline.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.ma: Maximum health points. Default: 56 (28 hearts); allowed: 1-1024. Raising this does not heal existing companions.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.at: Base melee damage before armor. Default: 8; allowed: 0-2048. Violet Dive adds 4 and Momentum adds up to 2.25 damage; Lance, Crosscut and Rupture use separate values.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.ar: Armor points used by normal Minecraft damage reduction. Default: 6; allowed: 0-30.
Protection against large hits penetrating armor. Default: 2; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.kn: 0 = no resistance; 1 = complete resistance. Default: 0.2; allowed: 0-1.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.mo: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Violet Overdrive temporarily adds 15%.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.fl: Autonomous and mounted horizontal flight speed. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Overdrive temporarily adds 15%; vertical controls remain shared.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.fo: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Abilities keep their own bounded ranges; larger sensing distances increase server work.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.toxic_: Discover a corrosive companion in a swamp or mangrove swamp.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.tooltip: Corrosion and area-denial companion. Acid applies temporary Armor Fracture and poison; she resists both. Shield reflection cannot chain recursively. Mounted G uses the shared 0.4-second cooldown.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.too: Adjust Toxic's base attributes. Defaults: 64 HP, 6 attack, 8 armor, 2 toughness, 35% knockback resistance and 48-block awareness. Ability values and ranges are separate.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.max: Maximum health points. Default: 64 (32 hearts); allowed: 1-1024. Raising this does not heal existing companions.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.att: Base melee damage before armor. Default: 6; allowed: 0-2048. Acid Dive adds 3; projectile, pulse and periodic area damage use separate values.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.arm: Armor points used by normal Minecraft damage reduction. Default: 8; allowed: 0-30.
Protection against large hits penetrating armor. Default: 2; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.kno: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.35; allowed: 0-1.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.mov: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Shared navigation remains unchanged.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.fly: Autonomous and mounted horizontal flight speed. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Vertical controls remain shared; this is not the legacy cruise-speed scale.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.fol: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 48; allowed: 4-128. Projectiles remain limited to 32 blocks; the toxic zone has a 10-block radius.

config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.stats.too: Adjust Sculk's base attributes. Defaults: 64 HP, 6 attack, 8 armor, 2 toughness, 35% knockback resistance and 48-block awareness. Ability values and ranges are separate.

config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.stats.mov: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Shared navigation remains unchanged.
config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.stats.fly: Autonomous and mounted horizontal flight speed. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Vertical controls remain shared; this is not the legacy cruise-speed scale.
config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.stats.fol: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 48; allowed: 4-128. Projectiles remain limited to 32 blocks; the sculk zone has a 10-block radius.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.ravage: Discover a Ravager Phantom near a Pillager Outpost or an active raid. He is not a raid member.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.tooltip: Heavy bruiser and siege mount. Nine core abilities; owner-mounted G starts combat Charge, and Ctrl starts the separate terrain-breaching Siege Charge. Both share Charge's 16-second cooldown.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.bulldoz: Allow charge-only clearing of tagged natural foliage. Persistent player leaves, containers, unbreakable and protected blocks stay safe. Requires mobGriefing and owner permission.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.siegeBr: Enable owner-mounted breaching of tagged blocks with sufficient momentum and a suitable held tool. Maximum forward profile: 3 x 3. Turning this off does not disable combat.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.stats.t: Base stats apply to loaded Ravager Phantoms within one second. Ability damage and temporary Fury bonuses are separate.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.stats.m: Health points; 2 = 1 heart. Default: 76; allowed: 1-1024. Increasing this does not heal existing companions.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.stats.a: Base physical Bite damage. Default: 9; allowed: 0-2048. Dive adds 5. Ram and Slam use separate fixed initial balance values.
Reduces armor penetration from heavy hits. Default: 3; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.stats.k: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.45; allowed: 0-1.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.stats.m: Base movement speed. Default: 0.22; allowed: 0.01-2. Fury adds a temporary 15% bonus.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.stats.f: Base autonomous and mounted horizontal flight speed. Default: 0.32; allowed: 0.01-2. Charge accelerates separately with capped momentum.
Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Presence radius is 8; Roar radius is 12.
message.phantomism.dimension_no_space: Your Phantom could not find a safe portal landing for you both.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.end_ph: Discover an End Phantom on the Outer End Islands. An agile rescuer, not a guarantee against the Void.
config.phantomism.endPhantom.tooltip: Nine-ability evasive rescuer. Owner-mounted G uses Rift Strike against an aimed hostile, otherwise attempts safe tactical teleportation. End Rescue is automatic and can fail outside reach or without safe ground.
config.phantomism.endPhantom.stats.toolt: Shared base stats apply to loaded End Phantoms within one second. Teleport ranges, rescue reach and temporary Eye bonuses are separate.
config.phantomism.endPhantom.stats.attac: Base Bite damage. Default: 7; allowed: 0-2048. Endermen, Endermites and Shulkers receive +3; the Ender Dragon receives +1.
config.phantomism.endPhantom.stats.knock: Default: 0.25; allowed: 0-1. Airborne End Adaptation adds 0.1 in the End; no Void immunity.
config.phantomism.endPhantom.stats.flyin: Default: 0.45; allowed: 0.01-2. Eye of Ender grants a temporary 15% bonus.
config.phantomism.endPhantom.stats.follo: Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Blink reaches 15 blocks; tactical teleport reaches 25. Rescue search remains bounded at 56.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.zombie: Discover a Zombie Phantom. Each individual may rise from a qualifying fatal hit only once, forever.
config.phantomism.zombiePhantom.stats.ma: Default: 76 HP; raising the maximum does not heal or recharge revival.
config.phantomism.zombiePhantom.stats.at: Default: 8; Bite adds 2, Dive adds 4. Spit deals 5 independent damage.
config.phantomism.zombiePhantom.stats.fl: Default: 0.32; also scales normal mounted horizontal movement.
config.phantomism.zombiePhantom.stats.fo: Default: 32; pursuit is bounded. Presence radius remains 12.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.skelet: Discover a Skeleton Phantom, an adaptive aerial marksman with a temporary calming presence.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.husk_p: Discover a Husk Phantom, a relentless desert tank who wears enemies down with Exhaustion.
config.phantomism.huskPhantom.stats.flyi: Default: 0.35 native flying speed, interpreting the nominal design speed of 7 as 7/20. Also scales normal mounted flight.
config.phantomism.huskExhaustionDuration: Default: 160 (8 seconds); allowed: 20-600. Reapplications refresh duration. Tiers can advance at most once per second per enemy across all Husks.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.echo_p: Discover an Echo Phantom, a cyan-winged specialist in coordinated follow-up attacks.
config.phantomism.echoPhantom.stats.flyi: Default: 0.425 native units per tick, targeting an 8.5 blocks/second straight cruise. Acceleration, turns and obstacles reduce actual speed.

codex.field.black_phantom.overview: A quick, watchful hunter that circles danger before committing to a dive. A nimble companion for roaming the skies and picking off exposed threats.
codex.field.black_phantom.riding: Ride an adult for agile travel. Its close-range attacks remain automatic; this species has no separate G attack.
codex.field.black_phantom.spawn: Appears in the Overworld when it is dark outside, with open sky and dry space to fly.
codex.field.black_phantom.ability.0.name: Hunter Sense
codex.field.black_phantom.ability.0.desc: Watches for nearby combat threats and signals what it has found. Let it scout ahead while you travel.
codex.field.black_phantom.ability.1.name: Diving Strike
codex.field.black_phantom.ability.1.desc: Swoops into close combat. Its bite gains an advantage against certain exposed or airborne targets.
codex.field.black_phantom.ability.2.name: Protective Shield
codex.field.black_phantom.ability.2.desc: Raises resistance when danger reaches the family, helping it survive a sudden exchange.
codex.field.black_phantom.ability.3.name: Sky Knight
codex.field.black_phantom.ability.3.desc: Briefly strengthens its combat abilities and changes its appearance. Best used by letting it stay engaged with a real threat.
codex.field.fire_phantom.overview: An aggressive flame-wielder that pressures enemies with burning bites and fiery shots. Give it space to keep dangerous creatures at a distance.
codex.field.fire_phantom.riding: G launches a fire projectile in the direction you face. Use ordinary flight controls to keep a clear firing line.
codex.field.fire_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed Overworld habitats by day or night. Look for open sky and dry air above the ground.
codex.field.fire_phantom.ability.0.name: Burning Bite
codex.field.fire_phantom.ability.0.descr: A close-range hit can set an enemy alight, adding pressure after the initial strike.
codex.field.fire_phantom.ability.1.name: Fire Projectile
codex.field.fire_phantom.ability.1.descr: Launches a fiery shot along a clear path. Useful for engaging enemies before they reach you.
codex.field.fire_phantom.ability.2.name: Fire Veil
codex.field.fire_phantom.ability.2.descr: Warms and strengthens nearby family members during combat.
codex.field.fire_phantom.ability.3.name: Fire Shield
codex.field.fire_phantom.ability.3.descr: Provides a defensive response when the family is threatened.
codex.field.fire_phantom.ability.4.name: Firestorm
codex.field.fire_phantom.ability.4.descr: Pulses fire damage around a dangerous fight, making clustered enemies easier to handle.
codex.field.fire_phantom.defense.0: Cannot freeze and is not slowed by powder snow.
codex.field.frost_phantom.overview: A cold-country hunter that slows the fight to its own pace. Frost attacks and protective ice effects give allies time to recover or reposition.
codex.field.frost_phantom.riding: G fires an ice projectile. Slow a target, then turn away or close in while it struggles to keep up.
codex.field.frost_phantom.spawn: Appears in cold habitats by day or night, with open sky and room to fly above dry ground.
codex.field.frost_phantom.ability.0.name: Frost Bite
codex.field.frost_phantom.ability.0.desc: A freezing close-range strike slows enemies and rewards fighting in cold surroundings.
codex.field.frost_phantom.ability.1.name: Ice Projectile
codex.field.frost_phantom.ability.1.desc: Fires an icy shot that slows a creature it hits. Useful for holding a pursuer back.
codex.field.frost_phantom.ability.2.name: Ice Shield
codex.field.frost_phantom.ability.2.desc: Grants temporary protection when nearby allies come under pressure.
codex.field.frost_phantom.ability.3.name: Ice Storm
codex.field.frost_phantom.ability.3.desc: Sweeps the nearby fight with repeated cold damage and slowing effects.
codex.field.frost_phantom.defense.0: Immune to freezing and powder-snow slowdown.
codex.field.earth_phantom.overview: A steady guardian that combines stone attacks with shields and temporary cover. Its presence can also encourage nearby plants to grow.
codex.field.earth_phantom.riding: G throws an Earth Bomb toward your aim. Position above suitable ground when you want its defensive cover to help.
codex.field.earth_phantom.spawn: Appears above its listed land habitats by day or night. It needs dry air and enough room for its body.
codex.field.earth_phantom.ability.0.name: Earth Bomb
codex.field.earth_phantom.ability.0.desc: Throws a stone attack that damages and staggers a target, interrupting its approach.
codex.field.earth_phantom.ability.1.name: Earth Shield
codex.field.earth_phantom.ability.1.desc: Protects the family when a threat draws close.
codex.field.earth_phantom.ability.2.name: Earth Wall
codex.field.earth_phantom.ability.2.desc: Raises temporary cover between allies and danger. Placement needs suitable ground and respects protected terrain.
codex.field.earth_phantom.ability.3.name: Earthquake
codex.field.earth_phantom.ability.3.desc: Shakes the nearby battlefield to damage and disrupt enemies.
codex.field.earth_phantom.ability.4.name: Earth Blessing
codex.field.earth_phantom.ability.4.desc: Occasionally helps nearby plants grow. It is a gentle benefit, not instant growth for an entire farm.
codex.field.water_phantom.overview: A water-adapted companion that can accompany you beneath the surface. Protective blessings and water attacks make it especially useful on aquatic journeys.
codex.field.water_phantom.riding: G fires a water projectile. You can remain mounted underwater; the companion does not automatically throw you off on entering water.
codex.field.water_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed waters by day or night. Search for enough water depth and open space to swim.
codex.field.water_phantom.ability.0.name: Water Blessing
codex.field.water_phantom.ability.0.desc: Helps nearby allies breathe underwater and offers protection while exploring water.
codex.field.water_phantom.ability.1.name: Water Projectile
codex.field.water_phantom.ability.1.desc: Fires a focused water attack toward a clear target.
codex.field.water_phantom.ability.2.name: Water Shield
codex.field.water_phantom.ability.2.desc: Responds to threats with a protective water effect for the family.
codex.field.water_phantom.ability.3.name: Hydro Pump
codex.field.water_phantom.ability.3.desc: Sustains a stronger stream of water against enemies during combat.
codex.field.water_phantom.defense.0: Breathes underwater and moves naturally through water.
codex.field.storm_phantom.overview: A storm-bearer that gathers power from lightning and the weather. Electrical attacks and protective thunder make it a lively companion in an unsettled sky.
codex.field.storm_phantom.riding: G launches a Storm Jolt. Keep an eye on its changing charge and appearance during stormy weather.
codex.field.storm_phantom.spawn: Appears by day or night in its listed habitats, with open sky and dry clearance. Rain or thunder is not required.
codex.field.storm_phantom.ability.0.name: Storm Charge
codex.field.storm_phantom.ability.0.desc: Absorbs natural lightning and stores charge. Weather can strengthen its attacks, but it does not need a thunderstorm to exist.
codex.field.storm_phantom.ability.1.name: Storm Jolt
codex.field.storm_phantom.ability.1.desc: Fires an electrical projectile toward an enemy in its line of fire.
codex.field.storm_phantom.ability.2.name: Thunder Shield
codex.field.storm_phantom.ability.2.desc: Provides a defensive response when an ally is threatened.
codex.field.storm_phantom.ability.3.name: Thunderstorm
codex.field.storm_phantom.ability.3.desc: Discharges electrical attacks around the fight, disrupting nearby enemies.
codex.field.sand_phantom.overview: A desert-adapted Phantom that wears opponents down with grit, impaired vision and sudden dives. It is most at home over dry, sandy terrain.
codex.field.sand_phantom.riding: G fires a Sand Bolt. Use the disruption to break pursuit or set up a closer attack.
codex.field.sand_phantom.spawn: Appears above its desert habitats by day or night. Search open, dry ground rather than enclosed caves.
codex.field.sand_phantom.ability.0.name: Desert Adaptation
codex.field.sand_phantom.ability.0.descr: Gains a combat advantage in suitable desert surroundings.
codex.field.sand_phantom.ability.1.name: Sand Bolt
codex.field.sand_phantom.ability.1.descr: Blasts a target with sand, damaging and hindering it.
codex.field.sand_phantom.ability.2.name: Desert Strike
codex.field.sand_phantom.ability.2.descr: Pressures enemies at close range with diving and biting attacks.
codex.field.sand_phantom.ability.3.name: Sandstorm
codex.field.sand_phantom.ability.3.descr: Surrounds nearby enemies with a storm that interferes with movement and vision.
codex.field.gold_phantom.overview: A gleaming companion with a powerful charged eye attack. It rewards careful positioning and enough time to finish a cast.
codex.field.gold_phantom.riding: G throws Gold Dust. Its stronger Golden Eye attack is automatic and needs time to charge.
codex.field.gold_phantom.spawn: Appears above its listed habitats by day or night, with open sky and enough dry flying space.
codex.field.gold_phantom.ability.0.name: Gold Dust
codex.field.gold_phantom.ability.0.descr: Fires a golden projectile that pressures an enemy from a distance.
codex.field.gold_phantom.ability.1.name: Golden Shield
codex.field.gold_phantom.ability.1.descr: Temporarily protects the family when danger approaches.
codex.field.gold_phantom.ability.2.name: Golden Eye
codex.field.gold_phantom.ability.2.descr: Charges a focused beam against a chosen enemy. A qualifying finishing blow can leave gold nuggets; keep its target in sight.
codex.field.gold_phantom.ability.3.name: Cave Sense
codex.field.gold_phantom.ability.3.descr: Notices nearby cave openings while exploring.
codex.field.cherry_phantom.overview: A gentle-looking guardian that prefers healing allies and fighting through clouds of petals. Keep it near companions who need room to recover.
codex.field.cherry_phantom.riding: G launches a Petal Barrage. Stay near injured allies if you want its support to reach them.
codex.field.cherry_phantom.spawn: Appears around its cherry-country habitats by day or night, with open sky and room above the ground.
codex.field.cherry_phantom.ability.0.des: Restores nearby family members and supports them with protective effects.
codex.field.cherry_phantom.ability.1.des: Launches petals at enemies instead of relying on repeated melee exchanges.
codex.field.cherry_phantom.ability.2.des: Helps shield allies during a dangerous fight.
codex.field.cherry_phantom.ability.3.des: Creates a supportive area that helps allies recover while hindering enemies.
codex.field.phantom_dragon.overview: A large, forceful aerial fighter that mixes fiery projectiles, sustained breath and close combat. It needs room to turn and a clear route to its prey.
codex.field.phantom_dragon.riding: G fires a Dragon Fireball, not the sustained breath attack. Leave enough space for this larger mount to maneuver.
codex.field.phantom_dragon.spawn: Appears around its listed highland habitats by day or night. This larger companion needs plenty of dry, open flying space.
codex.field.phantom_dragon.ability.0.des: Delivers a heavy close-range attack when it reaches an enemy.
codex.field.phantom_dragon.ability.1.des: Maintains a damaging breath attack against a suitable target. Solid terrain can block the attack.
codex.field.phantom_dragon.ability.2.des: Launches a fiery projectile from the air.
codex.field.phantom_dragon.ability.3.des: Briefly increases combat power and helps the dragon stay in the fight.
codex.field.phantom_dragon.ability.4.des: Supports its defense when the family is in danger.
codex.field.violet_phantom.overview: A graceful aerial duelist that becomes more dangerous as it strings together successful attacks. Open space helps it maintain pressure without losing its rhythm.
codex.field.violet_phantom.riding: G fires a Violet Lance. Its combos and Overdrive develop automatically as it fights.
codex.field.violet_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed habitats by day or night, with open sky and dry flying space.
codex.field.violet_phantom.ability.0.des: Builds momentum from successful combat actions. Missing opportunities can break its rhythm.
codex.field.violet_phantom.ability.1.des: Fires a focused ranged strike to begin or continue pressure.
codex.field.violet_phantom.ability.2.des: Cuts across nearby enemies with a forceful close-range attack.
codex.field.violet_phantom.ability.3.des: Releases an area attack against enemies clustered around the fight.
codex.field.violet_phantom.ability.4.des: Protects the companion when combat turns against it.
codex.field.violet_phantom.ability.5.des: Spends its built-up advantage on a brief period of stronger, faster combat.
codex.field.toxic_phantom.overview: A corrosive hunter that turns a crowded fight into a hazardous place for enemies. Its acid attacks weaken targets while protective effects spare the family.
codex.field.toxic_phantom.riding: G launches acid toward your aim. Let enemies gather before relying on its larger area attacks.
codex.field.toxic_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed habitats under open sky. It is easier to encounter after dark, though daytime encounters are possible.
codex.field.toxic_phantom.ability.0.name: Acid Projectile
codex.field.toxic_phantom.ability.0.desc: Fires acid at a target, adding poison pressure to the hit.
codex.field.toxic_phantom.ability.1.name: Corrosive Strike
codex.field.toxic_phantom.ability.1.desc: Uses close combat to keep pressure on enemies caught nearby.
codex.field.toxic_phantom.ability.2.name: Acid Shield
codex.field.toxic_phantom.ability.2.desc: Raises a protective acid effect when the fight threatens the family.
codex.field.toxic_phantom.ability.3.name: Acid Pulse
codex.field.toxic_phantom.ability.3.desc: Releases corrosive energy into a nearby group of enemies.
codex.field.toxic_phantom.ability.4.name: Acid Rain
codex.field.toxic_phantom.ability.4.desc: Keeps an area dangerous with repeated poison and weakening effects. Allies are not valid victims.
codex.field.toxic_phantom.defense.0: Immune to Poison and Armor Fracture.
codex.field.sculk_phantom.overview: A quiet inhabitant of ancient cities that keeps watch for nearby threats. Sonic attacks and suppression help it control a confined fight.
codex.field.sculk_phantom.riding: G releases a Sonic Beam. Choose a readable firing line rather than trying to attack through solid terrain.
codex.field.sculk_phantom.spawn: Search inside an Ancient City for a dry, open space. Being in the Deep Dark alone is not enough.
codex.field.sculk_phantom.ability.0.name: Vibration Sense
codex.field.sculk_phantom.ability.0.desc: Finds nearby combat threats and draws attention to them.
codex.field.sculk_phantom.ability.1.name: Sonic Beam
codex.field.sculk_phantom.ability.1.desc: Sends a focused sonic attack along its aim, useful against enemies lined up in front.
codex.field.sculk_phantom.ability.2.name: Silence
codex.field.sculk_phantom.ability.2.desc: Disrupts enemy movement and combat abilities inside its active field.
codex.field.sculk_phantom.ability.3.name: Sculk Shield
codex.field.sculk_phantom.ability.3.desc: Raises protection when nearby family members are threatened.
codex.field.ravager_phantom.overview: A heavy siege companion that answers threats with impacts, roaring force and relentless charges. Give it a wide approach and keep fragile surroundings out of its path.
codex.field.ravager_phantom.riding: G starts Siege Charge in your facing direction. Ctrl also requests its targeted siege charge. Use it only with a clear route.
codex.field.ravager_phantom.spawn: Look around illager strongholds and active raids. These are special encounters, not ordinary creatures scattered across every biome.
codex.field.ravager_phantom.ability.0.de: Hits a nearby enemy with a heavy impact and knockback.
codex.field.ravager_phantom.ability.1.de: Disrupts enemies around the companion and creates room for its allies.
codex.field.ravager_phantom.ability.2.de: Commits to a heavy impact against enemies below or nearby.
codex.field.ravager_phantom.ability.3.de: Drives through a clear path with substantial impact. Some terrain can break where world rules allow it.
codex.field.ravager_phantom.ability.4.de: Strengthens combat for a limited time; qualifying kills can help sustain it.
codex.field.ravager_phantom.note.0: Charges can break permitted terrain. Take care around builds.
codex.field.end_phantom.overview: An End-born companion that combines evasive movement with strikes across short gaps. Its rescues and blinks need somewhere safe to land.
codex.field.end_phantom.riding: G uses Rift Strike against a target ahead. With no suitable target, it instead tries a short forward teleport to safe ground.
codex.field.end_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed End habitats at any time, with dry space large enough for its body.
codex.field.end_phantom.ability.0.name: Blink
codex.field.end_phantom.ability.0.descri: Teleports to a nearby safe position, helping it reposition rather than cross every obstacle blindly.
codex.field.end_phantom.ability.1.name: Rift Strike
codex.field.end_phantom.ability.1.descri: Closes on an enemy with a spatial attack.
codex.field.end_phantom.ability.2.name: End Shield
codex.field.end_phantom.ability.2.descri: Protects the family during a dangerous exchange.
codex.field.end_phantom.ability.3.name: Eye of Ender
codex.field.end_phantom.ability.3.descri: Enters a stronger combat state that improves its pressure and evasive responses.
codex.field.end_phantom.ability.4.name: End Rescue
codex.field.end_phantom.ability.4.descri: Attempts a safety-checked rescue for an endangered companion or rider.
codex.field.end_phantom.note.0: A teleport can fail if no safe landing space exists.
codex.field.zombie_phantom.overview: A stubborn nocturnal companion that relies on infection and resilience rather than elegance. Its revival gives it another chance, not endless lives.
codex.field.zombie_phantom.riding: G launches Infection Spit. Its diving attacks are automatic; allow a reviving companion time to recover before mounting.
codex.field.zombie_phantom.spawn: Appears in the Overworld when it is dark outside. Search its listed habitats under open sky.
codex.field.zombie_phantom.ability.0.des: Fires an infectious projectile that harms enemies and applies its infection pressure.
codex.field.zombie_phantom.ability.1.des: Spreads infection through a successful close-range attack.
codex.field.zombie_phantom.ability.2.des: Commits to a diving strike against a reachable target.
codex.field.zombie_phantom.ability.3.des: Uses recovery and resistance to remain in combat.
codex.field.zombie_phantom.ability.4.des: Can recover from defeat when its limited revival is available. It cannot be ridden during revival.
codex.field.zombie_phantom.note.0: Revival is limited; do not treat this companion as immortal.
codex.field.skeleton_phantom.overview: A flying archer that adjusts its volleys to the threats in front of it. It is strongest with room to aim and clear sight of a group.
codex.field.skeleton_phantom.riding: G requests an Adaptive Volley in your facing direction. Walls and an obstructed firing line can prevent useful shots.
codex.field.skeleton_phantom.spawn: Appears in the Overworld after dark, with open sky and dry space above its listed habitats.
codex.field.skeleton_phantom.ability.0.d: Chooses an appropriate arrow volley for the enemies ahead.
codex.field.skeleton_phantom.ability.1.d: Rains arrows over a dangerous group instead of focusing every shot on one creature.
codex.field.skeleton_phantom.ability.2.d: Enters a focused state that improves its ranged combat.
codex.field.skeleton_phantom.ability.3.d: Raises a defensive response to protect itself during pressure.
codex.field.skeleton_phantom.ability.4.d: Weakens an enemy during a close combat exchange.
codex.field.husk_phantom.overview: A tireless desert hunter that exhausts enemies and pursues them with diving attacks. Its strength is sustained pressure, not a conventional ranged projectile.
codex.field.husk_phantom.riding: G selects the enemy you face: it bites at close range or begins a dive from farther away. There is no separate ranged shot.
codex.field.husk_phantom.spawn: Appears at night in its listed Overworld habitats. Look above open, dry ground.
codex.field.husk_phantom.ability.0.name: Drought
codex.field.husk_phantom.ability.0.descr: Wears down nearby enemies with exhausting desert pressure.
codex.field.husk_phantom.ability.1.name: Husk Dive
codex.field.husk_phantom.ability.1.descr: Closes on a reachable enemy and strikes on impact.
codex.field.husk_phantom.ability.2.name: Relentless
codex.field.husk_phantom.ability.2.descr: Improves pursuit during an active fight.
codex.field.husk_phantom.ability.3.name: Mummified Guard
codex.field.husk_phantom.ability.3.descr: Gives the companion a temporary defensive reprieve.
codex.field.husk_phantom.ability.4.name: Dead Land
codex.field.husk_phantom.ability.4.descr: Maintains an exhausting area around the battle.
codex.field.echo_phantom.overview: A patient observer that stores echoes of nearby combat. It spends that charge on adaptive attacks and protection rather than copying every power it sees.
codex.field.echo_phantom.riding: G fires an Echo Pulse; Ctrl requests Echo Strike. Its charge and available combat opportunities affect stronger actions.
codex.field.echo_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed Overworld habitats by day or night, with open sky and dry clearance.
codex.field.echo_phantom.ability.0.name: Echo Sense
codex.field.echo_phantom.ability.0.descr: Observes eligible attacks nearby and gathers Echo Charge.
codex.field.echo_phantom.ability.1.name: Echo Pulse
codex.field.echo_phantom.ability.1.descr: Launches a focused pulse to attack at range.
codex.field.echo_phantom.ability.2.name: Echo Strike
codex.field.echo_phantom.ability.2.descr: Uses stored combat opportunities for an adaptive close-range strike.
codex.field.echo_phantom.ability.3.name: Echo Guard
codex.field.echo_phantom.ability.3.descr: Spends its resources on a defensive response.
codex.field.echo_phantom.ability.4.name: Perfect Resonance
codex.field.echo_phantom.ability.4.descr: Uses accumulated charge for a stronger period of echo combat.
codex.field.blood_phantom.overview: A relentless hunter that turns successful attacks into staying power. It thrives when it can keep a chosen enemy under pressure.
codex.field.blood_phantom.riding: G fires its Blood Projectile and Ctrl requests a close-range Blood Strike. Successful combat helps sustain its draining style.
codex.field.blood_phantom.spawn: Appears at night in its listed Overworld surface habitats.
codex.field.blood_phantom.ability.0.name: Blood Projectile
codex.field.blood_phantom.ability.0.desc: Fires a blood-infused attack toward a target.
codex.field.blood_phantom.ability.1.name: Blood Drain
codex.field.blood_phantom.ability.1.desc: Recovers through eligible damage dealt in combat.
codex.field.blood_phantom.ability.2.name: Relentless Hunt
codex.field.blood_phantom.ability.2.desc: Improves pursuit of an active enemy.
codex.field.blood_phantom.ability.3.name: Crimson Wings
codex.field.blood_phantom.ability.3.desc: Supports its combat movement while it remains engaged.
codex.field.blood_phantom.ability.4.name: Blood Shield
codex.field.blood_phantom.ability.4.desc: Raises a protective shield and draws on its draining style to sustain it.
codex.field.blood_phantom.ability.5.name: Crimson Dominion
codex.field.blood_phantom.ability.5.desc: Extends its blood-themed pressure across the surrounding fight.
codex.field.vampire_phantom.overview: A night predator that mixes draining bites, evasive mist and influence over susceptible enemies. Its strongest moments come after dark.
codex.field.vampire_phantom.riding: G launches Crimson Bolt; Ctrl requests a draining bite against a nearby target.
codex.field.vampire_phantom.spawn: Appears at night above its listed Overworld surface habitats.
codex.field.vampire_phantom.ability.0.de: Adapts its combat state to the night.
codex.field.vampire_phantom.ability.1.de: Bites an enemy at close range and uses the attack to sustain its fighting style.
codex.field.vampire_phantom.ability.2.de: Fires a blood-colored projectile at a target.
codex.field.vampire_phantom.ability.3.de: Briefly helps it evade danger and unsettle nearby threats.
codex.field.vampire_phantom.ability.4.de: Temporarily influences eligible enemies. It cannot control every creature or keep an army forever.
codex.field.vampire_phantom.ability.5.de: Enters an aggressive combat state for a short time.
codex.field.vampire_phantom.ability.6.de: Amplifies its nighttime pressure across a larger fight.
codex.field.gravity_phantom.overview: A master of weight and motion that gathers, lifts and pins enemies. It is especially useful when the battlefield needs rearranging rather than simply more damage.
codex.field.gravity_phantom.riding: G launches a Gravity Well; Ctrl requests Gravity Crush. Friendly riders and companions are not freely thrown around by its control effects.
codex.field.gravity_phantom.spawn: Appears above its listed Overworld habitats by day or night.
codex.field.gravity_phantom.ability.0.de: Places a pulling well that gathers enemies near its impact.
codex.field.gravity_phantom.ability.1.de: Compresses a target with a damaging gravity attack.
codex.field.gravity_phantom.ability.2.de: Lifts an enemy into the air to interrupt its approach.
codex.field.gravity_phantom.ability.3.de: Displaces an enemy with a controlled throw.
codex.field.gravity_phantom.ability.4.de: Restricts an enemy's movement for a short time.
codex.field.gravity_phantom.ability.5.de: Controls enemies within a nearby area.
codex.field.gravity_phantom.ability.6.de: Creates a stronger gravity zone to control a difficult group.
codex.field.wither_phantom.overview: A dangerous Nether companion that combines withering strikes with adaptive skull volleys. Its sieges become most effective against a visible group of enemies.
codex.field.wither_phantom.riding: G fires an adaptive skull volley; Ctrl requests Wither Bite. It still needs suitable targets and a clear attack route.
codex.field.wither_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed Nether habitats below Y=120, with dry flying space. Overworld daylight does not matter here.
codex.field.wither_phantom.ability.0.des: A close-range attack that inflicts withering pressure.
codex.field.wither_phantom.ability.1.des: Launches a skull volley suited to the threats ahead.
codex.field.wither_phantom.ability.2.des: Bombards a group with a heavier sequence of skull attacks.
codex.field.wither_phantom.ability.3.des: Closes distance with an aggressive rush.
codex.field.wither_phantom.ability.4.des: Temporarily strengthens its defense during danger.
codex.field.wither_phantom.ability.5.des: Maintains a powerful area attack during a serious fight.
codex.field.chrono_phantom.overview: A measured companion that changes the pace of battle. It can buy allies time, disrupt enemies and help recover from a dangerous exchange.
codex.field.chrono_phantom.riding: G fires Time Bolt; Ctrl requests a temporal dive. Its protective time abilities activate automatically for suitable allies.
codex.field.chrono_phantom.spawn: Appears above its listed Overworld habitats by day or night.
codex.field.chrono_phantom.ability.0.des: Launches a temporal projectile to pressure a target.
codex.field.chrono_phantom.ability.2.des: Helps a threatened ally reposition safely.
codex.field.chrono_phantom.ability.3.des: Uses recent history to help an ally recover, within its recovery limits.
codex.field.chrono_phantom.ability.4.des: Protects an eligible ally against a dangerous turn in the fight.
codex.field.chrono_phantom.ability.5.des: Slows enemies inside a temporal field.
codex.field.chrono_phantom.ability.6.des: Briefly restricts enemies caught in its strongest temporal control.
codex.field.chrono_phantom.ability.7.des: Helps eligible ordinary abilities recover a little sooner. It does not shorten ultimates or revival.
codex.field.rift_phantom.overview: A spatial companion that opens safer routes through a chaotic fight. Its rifts reposition allies and enemies, but a destination still needs to be safe.
codex.field.rift_phantom.riding: G fires Rift Bolt; Ctrl requests Rift Dash. Use the Staff's spatial tools to mark and use its corridor.
codex.field.rift_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed Nether habitats below Y=117, away from the lowest boundary and with dry flying space.
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.0.name: Rift Bolt
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.0.descr: Fires a spatial attack at range.
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.1.name: Rift Dash
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.1.descr: Dashes toward a reachable combat opportunity.
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.2.name: Spatial Rescue
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.2.descr: Moves a threatened ally toward a safer position.
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.3.name: Rift Anchor
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.3.descr: Marks a useful spatial position for its movement abilities.
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.4.name: Enemy Throw
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.4.descr: Displaces a valid enemy instead of moving an ally into danger.
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.5.name: Spatial Step and Lock
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.5.descr: Uses short repositioning and movement restriction to control a fight.
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.6.name: Rift Corridor
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.6.descr: Links marked portal ends through its Staff utility. Both ends must pass safety checks.
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.7.name: Fractured Space
codex.field.rift_phantom.ability.7.descr: Overwhelms a larger area with spatial disruption.
codex.field.rift_phantom.note.0: Rifts require safe, reachable destinations; they do not guarantee passage through any terrain.
codex.field.sentinel_phantom.overview: A watchful guardian that stands between danger and the family. It defends legitimate threats rather than chasing every monster it can sense.
codex.field.sentinel_phantom.riding: G releases Sentinel Pulse; Ctrl requests Repulse. Stay near the ally you want it to protect.
codex.field.sentinel_phantom.spawn: Search its listed Overworld habitats and villages by day or night. It needs enough dry space to appear.
codex.field.sentinel_phantom.ability.0.d: Attempts to intercept attacks aimed at its owner, allies or villagers.
codex.field.sentinel_phantom.ability.1.d: Pushes an attacker away from its protected ally.
codex.field.sentinel_phantom.ability.2.d: Strikes enemies close to the position it is defending.
codex.field.sentinel_phantom.ability.3.d: Releases a defensive area pulse around the fight.
codex.field.sentinel_phantom.ability.4.d: Provides protection when danger reaches the family.
codex.field.sentinel_phantom.ability.5.d: Establishes a stronger defensive area for allies.
codex.field.demon_phantom.overview: An infernal bruiser that mixes breath attacks, meteors and draining aggression. It excels when it has room above the battle and a clear path to its target.
codex.field.demon_phantom.riding: G uses Demon Breath; Ctrl requests its close-range strike or dash. Overhead cover can limit meteor attacks.
codex.field.demon_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed Nether habitats below Y=117, away from the lowest boundary and with room to fly.
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.0.name: Infernal Bite and Drain
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.0.desc: Strikes nearby enemies and sustains itself through eligible combat damage.
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.1.name: Demon Breath
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.1.desc: Maintains a damaging breath attack along its aim.
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.2.name: Demon Dash
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.2.desc: Closes on a target with a forceful rush.
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.3.name: Infernal Wave
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.3.desc: Sweeps nearby enemies with an area attack.
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.4.name: Meteor Barrage
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.4.desc: Calls damaging meteors into suitable space above the fight.
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.5.name: Demonic Howl
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.5.desc: Disrupts enemies with a threatening howl.
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.6.name: Demon Form
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.6.desc: Enters a stronger aggressive state for a limited period.
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.7.name: Apocalypse
codex.field.demon_phantom.ability.7.desc: Unleashes its most demanding infernal area assault. It needs enough room for its meteors.
codex.field.spectral_phantom.overview: An elusive companion that slips around danger and chooses short, decisive attacks. Its ghostly movement has practical safety limits, especially with a rider.
codex.field.spectral_phantom.riding: G fires Spectral Lance; Ctrl requests Spectral Dive. Phasing does not allow unrestricted rider passage through solid blocks.
codex.field.spectral_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed Overworld habitats at night, or in its Nether habitats below Y=117 at any time.
codex.field.spectral_phantom.ability.0.d: Delivers a spectral close-range hit that can bypass part of a target's armor.
codex.field.spectral_phantom.ability.2.d: Commits to a quick attack along a safe route.
codex.field.spectral_phantom.ability.3.d: Repositions briefly to evade or approach a threat.
codex.field.spectral_phantom.ability.4.d: Marks a valid enemy to improve combat pressure.
codex.field.spectral_phantom.ability.5.d: Protects an ally with a spectral defense.
codex.field.spectral_phantom.ability.6.d: Enters an enhanced spectral state during a dangerous fight.
codex.field.angel_phantom.overview: A protective companion that watches for injured allies and dangerous attacks. Healing and interception make it valuable when the whole family needs to survive.
codex.field.angel_phantom.riding: G uses Smite; Ctrl requests a Guardian Dive. Remain close enough for its healing and protection to reach you.
codex.field.angel_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed Overworld habitats by day or night, with dry space to fly.
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.0.name: Healing Touch
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.0.desc: Restores an eligible injured ally and can cleanse dangerous effects.
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.1.name: Blessing
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.1.desc: Gives nearby allies additional recovery and protection.
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.2.name: Healing Trail
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.2.desc: Leaves a supportive trail for allies moving with it.
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.3.name: Smite
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.3.desc: Strikes a hostile target with a focused holy attack.
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.4.name: Guardian Dive
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.4.desc: Dives at a valid threat when it can reach one safely.
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.5.name: Shield and Interception
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.5.desc: Shields allies and attempts to intercept incoming danger.
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.6.name: Eye of Salvation
codex.field.angel_phantom.ability.6.desc: Creates a powerful sanctuary response for an endangered family.
codex.field.angel_phantom.note.0: Several Angels cannot endlessly multiply the same healing benefit.
codex.field.omen_phantom.overview: A tactical Phantom that directs pressure onto marked enemies and rallies allies around its standard. It is particularly alert to raider-related danger.
codex.field.omen_phantom.riding: G fires Omen Bolt; Ctrl requests its diving strike. Its marks and standard work automatically during combat.
codex.field.omen_phantom.spawn: Search its listed Overworld habitats and illager-related sites by day or night.
codex.field.omen_phantom.ability.0.name: Omen Mark
codex.field.omen_phantom.ability.0.descr: Marks a threat so the family can focus its attacks.
codex.field.omen_phantom.ability.1.name: Omen Standard
codex.field.omen_phantom.ability.1.descr: Rallies eligible allies around a supportive standard.
codex.field.omen_phantom.ability.2.name: Omen Bolt
codex.field.omen_phantom.ability.2.descr: Launches a focused projectile at a target.
codex.field.omen_phantom.ability.3.name: Omen Shield
codex.field.omen_phantom.ability.3.descr: Provides a defensive response during pressure.
codex.field.omen_phantom.ability.4.name: Omen Dive
codex.field.omen_phantom.ability.4.descr: Dives against a reachable marked threat.
codex.field.omen_phantom.ability.5.name: Calamity
codex.field.omen_phantom.ability.5.descr: Turns a larger fight into a coordinated assault with repeated judgments.
codex.field.ancient_phantom.overview: An old guardian of stone and ruined places. Marks, shields and sanctuaries help it protect a family while wearing down determined enemies.
codex.field.ancient_phantom.riding: G throws Ancient Stone; Ctrl requests Ruin Strike when close enough, otherwise a diving attack.
codex.field.ancient_phantom.spawn: Appears at night around its listed mountains, roomy underground caves and ancient ruins. Underground encounters need genuine open cave space.
codex.field.ancient_phantom.ability.0.de: Marks an enemy to support focused pressure.
codex.field.ancient_phantom.ability.1.de: Delivers a heavy close-range attack against a threat.
codex.field.ancient_phantom.ability.2.de: Throws an ancient stone projectile toward an enemy.
codex.field.ancient_phantom.ability.3.de: Protects a nearby ally during a dangerous exchange.
codex.field.ancient_phantom.ability.4.de: Establishes a protective area for eligible allies.
codex.field.ancient_phantom.ability.5.de: Closes on a reachable enemy with a diving attack.
codex.field.ancient_phantom.ability.6.de: Creates a larger field of protection and damaging judgments.
codex.field.reaper_phantom.overview: A grim hunter that notices weakened enemies and gathers souls from qualifying kills. Its strongest protections and attacks depend on what it has harvested.
codex.field.reaper_phantom.riding: G launches Soul Shard; Ctrl requests its close-range or passing strike. Keep its soul resource in mind before relying on its strongest responses.
codex.field.reaper_phantom.spawn: Search Soul Sand Valleys in the Nether at any time, or Dark Forests in the Overworld at night.
codex.field.reaper_phantom.ability.0.des: Identifies vulnerable, wounded enemies for focused attacks.
codex.field.reaper_phantom.ability.1.des: Cuts a nearby enemy with a soul-infused strike.
codex.field.reaper_phantom.ability.2.des: Pressures a weakened target with a stronger finishing attack.
codex.field.reaper_phantom.ability.3.des: Repositions to keep pressure on a reachable enemy.
codex.field.reaper_phantom.ability.5.des: Gathers souls from qualifying kills. Not every defeat provides a usable soul.
codex.field.reaper_phantom.ability.6.des: Uses its soul resource for a defensive recovery opportunity.
codex.field.reaper_phantom.ability.7.des: Unleashes repeated soul judgments across the battle.
codex.field.primordial_phantom.overview: An ancient companion that balances cosmic offense with restoration and protective wings. It supports the family while controlling a broad fight.
codex.field.primordial_phantom.riding: G launches Starfall; Ctrl requests its close-range strike or diving action. Remain near the family to share its protective support.
codex.field.primordial_phantom.spawn: Search End Highlands at any time. In the Overworld, search high mountains or deep Dripstone Caves at night.
codex.field.primordial_phantom.ability.0: Reduces pressure on nearby eligible family members.
codex.field.primordial_phantom.ability.1: Combines close-range cosmic strikes into a stronger sequence.
codex.field.primordial_phantom.ability.2: Launches a star projectile that breaks into a smaller burst on impact.
codex.field.primordial_phantom.ability.3: Raises a protective wing response around allies.
codex.field.primordial_phantom.ability.4: Repositions through a safety-checked cosmic movement.
codex.field.primordial_phantom.ability.5: Helps nearby allies recover during combat.
codex.field.primordial_phantom.ability.6: Disrupts enemies around a cosmic burst.
codex.field.primordial_phantom.ability.7: Combines protective support and repeated cosmic attacks over a large area.
codex.field.void_phantom.overview: A guardian of the End that restricts movement and disrupts dangerous enemy abilities. Its anchors and shields protect allies from more than ordinary damage.
codex.field.void_phantom.riding: G fires Void Bolt; Ctrl requests Void Step. Anchors need a valid safe destination and cannot rescue every situation.
codex.field.void_phantom.spawn: Appears in End Barrens and End Highlands at any time.
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.0.name: Void Survival and Null Field
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.0.descr: Survives the void and suppresses supported enemy teleportation or special attacks nearby.
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.1.name: Void Bolt
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.2.name: Void Grasp
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.2.descr: Restricts a target's movement; stronger enemies may resist full immobilization.
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.3.name: Abyss Anchor
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.3.descr: Offers an endangered ally a safety-checked return to an anchored position.
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.4.name: Anti-Caster Pulse and Seal
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.4.descr: Interrupts or delays supported enemy powers and weakens a selected target.
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.5.name: Void Step
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.5.descr: Repositions through a short, validated movement.
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.6.name: Dark Matter Shield
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.6.descr: Reduces incoming pressure on an eligible ally.
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.7.name: Null Horizon
codex.field.void_phantom.ability.7.descr: Creates a large suppression area that pulls and repeatedly damages enemies.
codex.field.dark_phantom.overview: A shadowy fighter that builds pressure through successful attacks in darkness. Protective bubbles and sudden rushes let it keep a threatening enemy occupied.
codex.field.dark_phantom.riding: G fires Darkness Bolt; Ctrl requests Dark Rush. Its stronger pressure is tied to successful combat, not merely standing in a dark place.
codex.field.dark_phantom.spawn: Appears at night above its listed forests and taigas, except in Peaceful difficulty. It needs supported dry ground and room for its body.
codex.field.dark_phantom.ability.0.name: Dark Pressure
codex.field.dark_phantom.ability.0.descr: Builds combat pressure from successful attacks, improving its darker fighting style.
codex.field.dark_phantom.ability.1.name: Darkness Bolt
codex.field.dark_phantom.ability.2.name: Dark Rend
codex.field.dark_phantom.ability.2.descr: Cuts a nearby enemy with a rapid close-range attack.
codex.field.dark_phantom.ability.3.name: Dark Rush
codex.field.dark_phantom.ability.3.descr: Closes on a reachable enemy along a safe path.
codex.field.dark_phantom.ability.4.name: Blackout
codex.field.dark_phantom.ability.4.descr: Interferes with enemy vision around a dangerous fight.
codex.field.dark_phantom.ability.5.name: Dark Bubble and Shield
codex.field.dark_phantom.ability.6.name: Dark Hour
codex.field.dark_phantom.ability.6.descr: Surrounds the battle with darkness and repeated blade attacks.
codex.field.phantom_king.overview: A crowned commander that rallies allied Phantoms and defends the family. His strength lies in coordinated attacks, momentum and a commanding presence.
codex.field.phantom_king.riding: G marks the enemy ahead with King's Judgment; Ctrl requests Royal Ram. Neither is a normal ranged projectile.
codex.field.phantom_king.spawn: Appears around its listed Overworld highlands and forests by day or night. Leave plenty of clearance for his larger body.
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.0.name: Royal Authority and Presence
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.0.descr: Coordinates eligible allied Phantoms and strengthens their fighting presence.
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.1.name: Royal Momentum
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.1.descr: Builds momentum through successful combat actions.
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.2.name: Royal Intercept
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.2.descr: Moves to protect endangered allies from legitimate threats.
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.3.name: Royal Ram
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.3.descr: Charges into a reachable enemy with a heavy impact.
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.4.name: King's Judgment
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.4.descr: Marks a chosen target so allied attacks can focus on it.
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.5.name: King's Strike and Roar
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.5.descr: Combines powerful close attacks with a disruptive rallying roar.
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.6.name: Royal Command and Guard
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.6.descr: Directs allied attacks and offers temporary protection.
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.7.name: King's Dominion
codex.field.phantom_king.ability.7.descr: Rallies the flock into a coordinated assault and a final royal judgment.
codex.field.phantom_king.note.0: He defends the family and follows attack orders rather than hunting unrelated monsters underground.
codex.field.golem_phantom.overview: A heavy guardian that watches over villagers and companions. Alongside powerful impacts, it can carry out authorized excavation and deliver what it collects.
codex.field.golem_phantom.riding: G uses Seismic Punch, choosing a hook or energy fist for the target's distance. Ctrl requests Golem Ram.
codex.field.golem_phantom.spawn: Search around villages and villager homes for a resident guardian. Returning repeatedly to one village does not guarantee another encounter.
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.0.name: Titanium Body
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.0.desc: Heavy defenses and slow recovery help it endure a prolonged fight.
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.1.name: Village Defender
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.1.desc: Responds to threats against its owner, allied companions and villagers.
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.2.name: Excavation and Delivery
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.2.desc: Uses Staff mining orders to collect permitted blocks into its 27-slot cargo and deliver them to its owner or a chosen chest.
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.3.name: Golem Ram
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.3.desc: Crashes into a reachable enemy with a forceful charge.
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.4.name: Golem Slam
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.4.desc: Damages and disrupts enemies with an impact attack.
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.5.name: Seismic Punch
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.5.desc: Uses a titanium hook at close range or an energy fist against a distant target.
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.6.name: Iron Guard
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.6.desc: Protects nearby allies when the family is under pressure.
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.7.name: Titan's Impact
codex.field.golem_phantom.ability.7.desc: Uses a grounded shockwave or airborne impact to strike a group.
codex.field.golem_phantom.defense.0: Immune to ordinary arrows; magic, explosions and special attacks can still threaten it.
codex.field.golem_phantom.note.0: Mining needs an explicit Staff order and respects protected terrain.
codex.field.mirage_phantom.overview: A deceptive companion that diverts attacks with copies, doubles and reflective defenses. Appearances can be borrowed; another Phantom's real powers cannot.
codex.field.mirage_phantom.riding: G fires Mirage Bolt; Ctrl requests Illusory Strike. Its copies are not a way to gain the copied species' abilities.
codex.field.mirage_phantom.spawn: Appears in Flower Forests, Meadows and Dark Forests by day or night.
codex.field.mirage_phantom.ability.0.des: Creates visual distractions to misdirect enemies.
codex.field.mirage_phantom.ability.1.des: Creates a physical decoy that can intercept attacks.
codex.field.mirage_phantom.ability.2.des: Fires a magical projectile through a clear firing line.
codex.field.mirage_phantom.ability.3.des: Uses a deceptive close-range attack against a suitable target.
codex.field.mirage_phantom.ability.4.des: Uses a decoy response to help an endangered ally.
codex.field.mirage_phantom.ability.5.des: Creates an area of visual confusion around the battle.
codex.field.mirage_phantom.ability.7.des: Fills the fight with a stronger collection of misleading doubles and mirror effects.
codex.field.eclipse_phantom.overview: A balanced companion that shifts between solar support and lunar aggression. Its stance changes with the needs of the fight rather than a manual stance command.
codex.field.eclipse_phantom.riding: G fires Eclipse Bolt; Ctrl requests Hybrid Rend. Solar and Lunar stances change automatically.
codex.field.eclipse_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed mountain, Cherry Grove and Meadow habitats by day or night.
codex.field.eclipse_phantom.ability.0.de: Switches automatically between Solar and Lunar stances, building momentum through combat.
codex.field.eclipse_phantom.ability.1.de: Provides protective and restorative support in its solar state.
codex.field.eclipse_phantom.ability.2.de: Favors close attacks and pursuit in its lunar state.
codex.field.eclipse_phantom.ability.3.de: Fires a ranged attack shaped by its current stance.
codex.field.eclipse_phantom.ability.4.de: Spends its combat advantage on a stronger close-range attack.
codex.field.eclipse_phantom.ability.5.de: Protects the family during a dangerous exchange.
codex.field.eclipse_phantom.ability.6.de: Combines its light and dark strengths across a larger fight.
codex.field.shadow_phantom.overview: A quiet, elusive hunter that prefers vulnerable targets and attacks from unexpected angles. Darkness helps it conceal its approach before a sudden burst.
codex.field.shadow_phantom.riding: G launches Shadow Bolt; Ctrl requests Shadow Dive. Reposition before committing to an isolated target.
codex.field.shadow_phantom.spawn: Appears in its listed Dark Forest and Taiga habitats at night.
codex.field.shadow_phantom.ability.0.des: Reduces its visibility to enemies and flies with very little noise.
codex.field.shadow_phantom.ability.1.des: Favors isolated or vulnerable targets over a tightly packed group.
codex.field.shadow_phantom.ability.3.des: Uses sudden close-range hits and diving attacks to punish an exposed enemy.
codex.field.shadow_phantom.ability.4.des: Repositions or briefly slips from enemy attention to escape or set up another approach.
codex.field.shadow_phantom.ability.5.des: Reveals nearby threats for a limited time and range.
codex.field.shadow_phantom.ability.6.des: Provides protection when the owner or an ally is threatened.
codex.field.shadow_phantom.ability.7.des: Covers a fight in darkness and repeated shadow attacks.
codex.field.plague_phantom.overview: A patient spreader of disease that becomes dangerous when enemies remain close together. Its family benefits from protection against the infection it creates.
codex.field.plague_phantom.riding: G launches Plague Spit; Ctrl requests Viral Dive. Its larger infection effects are most useful against groups.
codex.field.plague_phantom.spawn: Appears in Swamps and Dark Forests at night.
codex.field.plague_phantom.ability.0.des: Infects enemies and weakens them as the infection develops.
codex.field.plague_phantom.ability.1.des: Finds opportunities for infection to spread between nearby enemies. Spread has a limited reach and number of victims.
codex.field.plague_phantom.ability.2.des: Protects eligible family members from its infection and supports their resistance.
codex.field.plague_phantom.ability.3.des: Launches an infectious projectile at a target.
codex.field.plague_phantom.ability.4.des: Strikes a target and spreads infection around the impact.
codex.field.plague_phantom.ability.5.des: Leaves a lingering infectious area for enemies to pass through.
codex.field.plague_phantom.ability.6.des: Temporarily creates a corrupted helper from a suitable infected enemy. These helpers do not provide loot or experience.
codex.field.plague_phantom.ability.7.des: Spreads stronger infection pressure across a larger battle.
codex.field.crystal_phantom.overview: A crystalline guardian that turns incoming punishment into stored force. Barriers and counters help it hold a position while allies recover.
codex.field.crystal_phantom.riding: G fires Crystal Shard; Ctrl requests Crystal Counter. Stored Impact affects the strength of its retaliation.
codex.field.crystal_phantom.spawn: Appears in Stony Peaks and Windswept Hills by day or night, with dry flying space.
codex.field.crystal_phantom.ability.0.de: Uses crystalline defenses and gradual recovery to withstand a prolonged exchange.
codex.field.crystal_phantom.ability.1.de: Can reflect eligible incoming attacks. Reflection is not guaranteed against every weapon.
codex.field.crystal_phantom.ability.2.de: Builds charges from real damage taken, then spends them on stronger abilities.
codex.field.crystal_phantom.ability.4.de: Scatters crystal attacks across nearby enemies.
codex.field.crystal_phantom.ability.5.de: Spends stored impact on a powerful retaliatory hit.
codex.field.crystal_phantom.ability.6.de: Protects the family and responds defensively to heavy damage.
codex.field.crystal_phantom.ability.7.de: Controls a larger area with crystalline defense, disruption and a final eruption.
codex.field.obsidian_phantom.overview: A dense, volcanic guardian that protects allies through anchoring, shelter and punishing impacts. It trades agility for the ability to hold a difficult position.
codex.field.obsidian_phantom.riding: G fires Obsidian Shard; Ctrl requests Obsidian Ram. An anchored Bastion must release its stance before moving freely.
codex.field.obsidian_phantom.spawn: Search Nether Wastes and Basalt Deltas below the Nether roof. It needs dry space for its full body; mountain habitats are not where to look.
codex.field.obsidian_phantom.ability.0.d: Uses heavy defense and volcanic heat to endure combat and strengthen pressure.
codex.field.obsidian_phantom.ability.1.d: Fires a heavy shard at a visible target.
codex.field.obsidian_phantom.ability.2.d: Crashes into a reachable enemy with a forceful impact.
codex.field.obsidian_phantom.ability.3.d: Disrupts enemies with a heavy area impact.
codex.field.obsidian_phantom.ability.4.d: Anchors in a defensive stance when protecting a position. It cannot freely move while anchored.
codex.field.obsidian_phantom.ability.5.d: Protects nearby allies within a temporary shelter.
codex.field.obsidian_phantom.ability.6.d: Responds to heavy danger with protection and weakens enemy armor.
codex.field.obsidian_phantom.ability.7.d: Turns the surrounding fight into a powerful defensive zone with repeated obsidian attacks.
codex.field.gale_phantom.overview: A master of wind and aerial movement. Rapid flight, rescue updrafts and disruptive wind attacks make it an excellent companion for travel and mobile battles.
codex.field.gale_phantom.riding: G fires Wind Bolt; Ctrl arms Gale Rush while you keep steering. Slipstream and rescue support activate automatically when needed.
codex.field.gale_phantom.spawn: Appears in Windswept Hills, Meadows and Jagged Peaks by day or night, alone or with one other Gale.
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.0.name: Windborne Flight
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.0.descr: Turns and accelerates quickly in the air, while its Tailwind Aura supports nearby aerial allies.
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.1.name: Flight Rescue
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.1.descr: Helps a falling ally with an updraft and Slow Falling when rescue is possible.
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.2.name: Wind Bolt
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.2.descr: Fires a focused wind projectile with light knockback.
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.3.name: Slipstream
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.3.descr: Temporarily increases flight speed for travel or repositioning.
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.4.name: Updraft
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.4.descr: Lifts and disrupts enemies while helping eligible allies gain height.
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.5.name: Crosswind and Air Blade
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.5.descr: Pushes threats away and cuts across enemies with wind attacks.
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.6.name: Gale Rush and Vortex
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.6.descr: Combines a quick impact attack with a pulling wind field.
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.7.name: Sky Dominion
codex.field.gale_phantom.ability.7.descr: Sustains a large windstorm that controls enemies and aids aerial allies before a final burst.
codex.field.spore_phantom.overview: A living fungal guardian that uses spores and mushroom growth to control territory, weaken enemies and support nearby allies.
codex.field.spore_phantom.riding: G fires Spore Breath; Ctrl arms Decay Dive while normal rider steering is preserved. Support zones activate automatically around injured allies.
codex.field.spore_phantom.spawn: Appears in Swamps, Mangrove Swamps and Mushroom Fields by day or night, alone or in pairs. Search dry space above the ground or canopy.
codex.field.spore_phantom.ability.0.name: Spore Breath
codex.field.spore_phantom.ability.0.desc: Fires poisonous spores and leaves a short-lived cloud at impact. Use it to pressure an approach without harming the family.

codex.field.spore_phantom.ability.1.desc: Creates a temporary fungal zone that heals allies and slows enemies for eight seconds. Mushroom growth is visual, not permanent terrain.
codex.field.spore_phantom.ability.2.name: Decay Dive
codex.field.spore_phantom.ability.2.desc: Hits an enemy with a heavy impact, a spore burst and brief Weakness.
codex.field.spore_phantom.ability.3.name: Fungal Storm
codex.field.spore_phantom.ability.3.desc: Maintains a twelve-second fungal zone that damages and weakens enemies while giving allies modest recovery.
codex.field.spore_phantom.note.0: Wild Spore is peaceful unless threatened. The family is protected from its harmful spores.
