codex.ui.start.welcome.title: Welcome to Phantomism
codex.ui.start.welcome: The skies hold many kinds of Phantom, each with its own habits and strengths. Meet them, learn their ways and find the companions that suit your adventures.
codex.ui.start.finding.title: Finding Your First Phantom
codex.ui.start.finding: Browse Species for habitat and encounter clues. Some are common wanderers; others need a special place or time. Move within 16 blocks or interact to record a discovery.
codex.ui.start.taming.title: How to Tame a Phantom
codex.ui.start.taming: Use a Phantom Staff on an untamed Phantom for a sure bond. Some species also accept their own taming items; their discovered pages tell you which ones work. A tempting item is not always a taming item.
codex.ui.start.staff.title: Using the Phantom Staff
codex.ui.start.staff: Hold the Staff and right-click the air to open its menu. Select a companion or the nearby group. Follow keeps companions with you; Stay holds a position. Attack Target lets you choose a foe, Retreat ends the fight, and Recall calls them back when it is safe.
codex.ui.start.home.title: Giving a Companion a Home
codex.ui.start.home: Choose Set Home from the Staff menu, then sneak-right-click a bed. Use Return Home to send the companion there. A home needs a safe place to return to.
codex.ui.start.riding.title: Flying With Your Companion
codex.ui.start.riding: Interact with your tamed adult Phantom using an empty hand to mount. Use movement keys to steer, Jump to rise and your Sprint binding to descend. Where available, Ctrl uses a close attack or dash and G uses the species' secondary action. Check its page and your Controls menu; not every species uses both.
codex.ui.start.codex.title: Understanding Your Codex
codex.ui.start.codex: Portraits and habitat clues help you identify a Phantom before discovery. Its combat, taming and ability notes open only after you meet it. Abilities such as support and ultimates are normally used automatically; the Staff is for directing your companions.
codex.ui.start.care.title: Caring for the Family
codex.ui.start.care: Use Phantom Membranes to help an injured companion. Give large Phantoms room to fly and a clear route to their target. If an action fails, check the target, distance, terrain and recovery time before trying again.
codex.field.ancient_phantom.taming: Craft an Ancient Relic with an Echo Shard surrounded by eight Stone Bricks.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.solar_: Meet the white-gold sovereign of the daylight skies.
advancements.phantomism.celestial_bond.d: Witness Solar and a Lunar counterpart complete Total Eclipse together.
codex.field.solar_phantom.overview: A peaceful celestial sovereign who becomes a fierce protector when the family is threatened. Golden beams, rapid comet strikes and radiant sanctuaries let him move between offense and rescue.
codex.field.solar_phantom.spawn: A rare solitary wanderer in the listed Overworld habitats. Search under clear, open sky during daylight. He does not appear at night, in rain or underground.
codex.field.solar_phantom.riding: G fires Quick Beam over 42 blocks, with a 0.3-second shot interval. Ctrl starts Sunflare Blitz; a strong target can prompt a charged Comet Strike. Keep steering normally: the burst never teleports you through terrain. Support and Supernova remain automatic.
codex.field.solar_phantom.defense.0: Immune to ordinary fire, lava and burning. Indirect magical hits deal less damage, but bosses and other attacks can still hurt him.
codex.field.solar_phantom.note.0: Sunlight strengthens Solar; night and other dimensions leave his normal strength intact. His attacks avoid the owner and allies, and major explosions do not break terrain.
codex.field.solar_phantom.ability.0.name: Solar Empowerment
codex.field.solar_phantom.ability.0.desc: Direct, clear Overworld daylight strengthens solar damage by 20%, healing by 15% and ordinary flight by 10%. Solar ability recovery runs 15% faster; mounted Quick Beam retains its own shot interval. Gale still flies faster.
codex.field.solar_phantom.ability.1.name: Solar Annihilation
codex.field.solar_phantom.ability.1.desc: Quick Beam deals up to 20 damage per target; a 1.5-second charge raises this to 36. The 42-block beam and impact share one hit budget, including four short solar-scorch pulses. Automatic recovery is three or seven seconds, depending on the mode.
codex.field.solar_phantom.ability.2.name: Radiant Sanctuary
codex.field.solar_phantom.ability.2.desc: Heals allies for up to 16 HP over eight seconds with Resistance I, while scorching threats. An emergency form restores up to 28 HP over ten seconds with Resistance II. The modes share a 25- or 45-second recovery; their radii are ten and twelve blocks.
codex.field.solar_phantom.ability.3.name: Sunflare Blitz
codex.field.solar_phantom.ability.3.desc: A quick dash reaches twelve blocks and deals 18 damage. Charged Comet Strike reaches twenty-two blocks and deals 32. Each enemy can be hit only once per burst. The modes share an eight- or eighteen-second recovery.
codex.field.solar_phantom.ability.4.name: Supernova Ascension
codex.field.solar_phantom.ability.4.desc: A twelve-second, four-phase display of ascension, judgment, cataclysm and allied salvation. Judgment allows two 18-damage beams, one 75-damage blast and one 8-damage fragment hit per enemy. Salvation trades offense for a 40-damage blast, weaker beams and 36 HP of allied healing with Resistance II. Both forms share the same recovery.

advancements.phantomism.discovery.illage: Meet an independent commander above an outpost or village raid.
codex.field.illager_phantom.overview: A disciplined airborne commander, combining spectral crossbows, axe cleaves and emerald magic. Despite his familiar colors, he answers to no raiding party. Once bonded, his loyalty belongs entirely to his owner.
codex.field.illager_phantom.role: Tactical airborne bruiser and protective summoner
codex.field.illager_phantom.spawn: An uncommon independent encounter above Pillager Outposts, or occasionally near an active village raid. He never joins a raid wave, and his presence cannot keep a defeated raid alive. Day and night are both possible.
codex.field.illager_phantom.riding: G fires a three-bolt barrage over 42 blocks, with a 0.3-second mounted interval. Ctrl readies a Wrath cleave: steer into contact normally. The Staff and automatic barrage use five seconds and share the same recovery clock with mounted shots.
codex.field.illager_phantom.defense.0: Heavy armor and strong knockback resistance support deliberate, controlled aerial attacks. He has no special immunity to ordinary weapons.
codex.field.illager_phantom.note.0: Wild commanders are neutral until provoked. His magic spares the owner and protected companions, and never destroys terrain. Retreating ends ongoing assaults and dismisses temporary summons.
codex.field.illager_phantom.ability.0.de: Nearby ordinary raiders stop targeting the owner and protected companions. A raider who hurts the family, or receives an explicit attack order, breaks the charm individually. Ravager Phantom is unaffected. The charm fades outside the commander’s presence.
codex.field.illager_phantom.ability.1.de: Three predictive spectral bolts deal six damage each. The commander can distribute them among hostile enemies or pierce a close formation. Automatic and Staff recovery is five seconds.
codex.field.illager_phantom.ability.2.de: A controlled aerial approach ends in a heavy spectral axe cleave: 24 damage to the primary foe and 12 to nearby enemies within five blocks. Solid terrain interrupts the approach.
codex.field.illager_phantom.ability.3.de: Calls up to three spectral Vexes for twenty seconds and raises fangs beneath nearby foes. Overlapping fangs share one eight-damage hit per enemy. Summons follow the commander’s targets, never his allies.
codex.field.illager_phantom.ability.4.de: Marks enemies in an eighteen-block field, then coordinates suppression volleys, Vexes, fangs and a final execution cleave. Prelude damage is capped at thirty per enemy; execution adds up to 45 to the primary foe or 25 to nearby marked enemies. Other abilities keep their own recovery.

advancements.phantomism.discovery.infern: Meet the horned striker of the Nether lava skies.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.overview: A fierce, loyal aerial striker whose charcoal wings and crimson horns brighten as battle builds his Heat. His original infernal arts combine rapid fire, deliberate charges and controlled supernatural firestorms.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.role: Aggressive aerial striker and infernal area controller
codex.field.infernal_phantom.spawn: Rare and usually solitary in Nether Wastes and Basalt Deltas. Search below the Nether roof, above clear terrain or lava lakes. Other Nether habitats and the Overworld are not natural homes.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.riding: Hold G to aim and fire Infernal Bolt every two game ticks: ten shots per second, no ammunition, 32-block reach. Ctrl starts Hellrush; continue steering normally to make contact. AI and Staff use controlled three-shot bursts and the same recovery clock, not mounted firing speed.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.defense.0: Immune to fire, lava and burning, with heavy armor and strong knockback resistance. Other damage still hurts him.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.note.0: Heat comes from successful, valid direct attacks, not environmental damage, self-harm or friendly targets. Consuming Heat cannot feed itself. His firestorms and eruptions never place lava, ignite blocks or destroy terrain.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.ability.0.d: Heat rises from Dormant through Kindled and Blazing to Overheated. Three qualifying hits earn one level, with at most one gain per second. Each level modestly strengthens attacks; idle Heat decays by one level every ten seconds.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.ability.1.d: Fire, lava and burning cannot harm him. Fighting in the Nether gives a small offensive advantage, but environmental heat never creates combat Heat.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.ability.2.d: Nearby valid enemies receive brief Weakness while he is fighting. At maximum Heat they also receive a short slowdown. The pressure fades quickly and never changes their permanent behavior.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.ability.3.d: Fires fast, non-explosive fireballs for five base damage and brief burning. AI and Staff fire three controlled shots over a three-second recovery; mounted held fire uses exactly two ticks per shot. Heat changes damage, not the mounted interval.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.ability.4.d: A collision-checked aerial charge deals 26 base damage to the primary foe and 12 to hostile enemies within four blocks, with burning and knockback. One charge can hit each enemy only once.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.ability.5.d: An eight-second, ten-block zone applies periodic supernatural heat and five visual magma eruptions. Enemies are slowed, and nearby eligible tamed Phantoms receive brief offensive support. No permanent terrain is placed.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.ability.6.d: Consumes all accumulated Heat for a nearby fiery burst. Heat levels one, two and three release increasingly strong shockwaves, reaching thirty base damage at level three. Its own damage cannot regenerate the resource.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.ability.7.d: A quick six-block ash burst deals twelve base damage, brief burning, impaired visibility and knockback. Use it for immediate crowd control rather than sustained area pressure.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.ability.8.d: Automatically answers meaningful enemy pressure against himself or nearby protected allies. A five-second cinder shield reduces eligible incoming damage by 35% and repels nearby threats. Multiple guards do not stack, and it has a thirty-second recovery.
codex.field.infernal_phantom.ability.9.d: A twelve-second sequence of Infernal Awakening, Hellfire Barrage, Infernal Dominion and Ascendant Impact. All phases share a per-target direct-damage ceiling of 65 for the primary foe or 35 for other marked enemies. Its supernatural burning is accounted for inside those phase budgets, not added as uncontrolled native fire damage. Retreat or invalid targets interrupt it without refunding recovery.
staff.ability.tip.infernal_phantom.bolt: Pressure a visible foe in controlled bursts; while mounted, hold G for rapid aimed fire.
staff.ability.tip.infernal_phantom.hellr: Punish a reachable enemy through a clear diving route, especially with other foes nearby.
staff.ability.tip.infernal_phantom.field: Control an approach where enemies will stay and allied Phantoms can fight nearby.
staff.ability.tip.infernal_phantom.overh: Build Heat first, then spend it when several nearby enemies are worth the burst.
staff.ability.tip.infernal_phantom.ash: Push back a nearby crowd when you need immediate breathing room.
staff.ability.tip.infernal_phantom.ascen: Save for a major open-space battle with several threats or a durable priority enemy.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.lunar_: Meet a silver-winged sovereign beneath an open night sky.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.overview: A calm, observant celestial companion. Silver crescents brighten across her midnight wings as precise attacks build momentum. She remains capable by day, but feels most at home beneath the moon.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.role: Precision striker, evasive damage dealer and offensive support
codex.field.lunar_phantom.spawn: Rare, usually solitary nighttime encounters beneath open skies in Meadows, Taiga and Windswept Hills. Any moon phase is suitable.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.riding: Aim Moon Lance with G; mounted recovery is 0.3 seconds and its reach is 42 blocks. Ctrl uses Moon Fang against a close foe under your aim. Other abilities remain available through the Staff.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.defense.0: Heavy celestial armor with a brief reactive Moonlit Veil. Evasion and careful positioning matter; she has no blanket damage immunity.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.note.0: She cooperates naturally with a nearby Solar companion. Cooperation between different owners needs mutual authorization, and neither celestial requires a partner.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.0.name: Lunar Charge
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.0.desc: Celestial energy builds through successful combat and natural moonlight. Dormant, Crescent, Gibbous and Full Moon are useful stages, not restrictions on when she may fight.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.1.name: Night Hunter
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.1.desc: Nightfall sharpens her aerial maneuvering and offensive precision. Daylight never disables her abilities.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.2.name: Lunar Pressure
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.2.desc: Successful attacks build a separate, short-lived offensive momentum. Pressure falls away after combat instead of replacing stored Lunar Charge.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.3.name: Lunar Recovery
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.3.desc: Quiet recovery windows restore a little health, more comfortably under moonlight. Recently suffered damage interrupts this recovery.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.4.name: Lunar Aura
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.4.desc: Nearby protected companions receive modest movement support. Her owner and authorized allies also gain continuous night vision within 30 blocks, ending when they leave her radius. Multiple auras do not stack into stronger versions.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.5.name: Moon Lance
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.5.desc: A swift silver-blue lance pierces a limited number of valid foes. It respects walls, distance and friendly protection.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.6.name: Moon Fang
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.6.desc: A precise close-range strike rewards careful positioning and briefly slows its victim.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.7.name: Lunar Rush
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.7.desc: An evasive aerial charge follows a clear route to one foe. Terrain blocks the rush, and a single charge cannot repeatedly damage its target.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.8.name: Crescent Slash
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.8.desc: A broad forward crescent sweeps grouped enemies, striking each once and briefly disrupting movement.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.9.name: Moonbreak
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.9.desc: A deliberate heavy strike punishes an important foe and briefly fractures armor without permanently altering its defenses.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.10.des: A controlled moonlight wave disrupts nearby foes and offers secondary healing to eligible allies.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.11.des: A short reactive veil softens incoming blows and protects her mounted owner. It is neither permanent protection nor terrain phasing.
codex.field.lunar_phantom.ability.12.des: Celestial Awakening gathers a spectral moon; Moonlight Dominion releases precise lances; Crescent Judgment sweeps the battlefield; Full Moon Impact finishes the sequence. All phases share strict per-target damage limits.
staff.ability.tip.lunar_phantom.lance: Pressure a visible distant foe, especially when several enemies line up.
staff.ability.tip.lunar_phantom.fang: Use when a priority enemy is already close enough for a precise bite.
staff.ability.tip.lunar_phantom.rush: Close a clear aerial gap or reposition onto an isolated foe; walls stop the charge.
staff.ability.tip.lunar_phantom.slash: Sweep a group clustered ahead of you rather than enemies scattered behind.
staff.ability.tip.lunar_phantom.moonbrea: Punish a durable or armored priority threat before following with other attacks.
staff.ability.tip.lunar_phantom.pulse: Use when nearby allies need a little healing and hostile pressure is close.
staff.ability.tip.lunar_phantom.ascendan: Save for a major fight with several threats or a durable enemy in clear space.

codex.field.autumn_phantom.overview: A quiet forest guardian whose amber wings drift with the changing leaves. A permanent year-round companion, not a Holiday Phantom.
codex.field.autumn_phantom.role: Forest guardian, harvest utility and restorative support
codex.field.autumn_phantom.defense.0: Short seasonal wards soften nearby danger without stacking indefinitely.
codex.field.autumn_phantom.note.0: Harvesting starts disabled. Select an approved crop/vegetation area with the Staff; wood approval applies to one selected log only.
codex.field.autumn_phantom.riding: G fires Autumn Bolt. Left Control requests Leaf Rush. Other abilities use the shared Staff interface.
codex.spawn.autumn_phantom: Dappled Forest when registered; configurable temperate-forest fallback otherwise. Available day and night, year-round.
codex.field.autumn_phantom.ability.0.des: Subtle drifting leaves accompany her flight. While actively guarding, a light seasonal ward supports nearby allies.
codex.field.autumn_phantom.ability.1.des: Patiently notices mature crops and approved plants in the owner-selected area. Only the owner sees her subtle resource markers.
codex.field.autumn_phantom.ability.2.des: A compressed swirl of autumn leaves presses a visible foe back. Not fire magic.
codex.field.autumn_phantom.ability.3.des: A brief, collision-safe aerial strike reaches a nearby foe once, then returns to normal flight.
codex.field.autumn_phantom.ability.4.des: A temporary circle of leaves protects eligible nearby allies when danger is present.
codex.field.autumn_phantom.ability.5.des: A restorative breeze helps injured allies. Owner-selected harvesting gathers mature crops, replants with available drops and reuses companion cargo delivery.
codex.field.autumn_phantom.ability.6.des: An eight-second leaf vortex disrupts engaged enemies and supports allies with a modest seasonal ward.

staff.ability.tip.autumn_phantom.bolt: Pressure a visible foe beyond melee range; the leaves do not ignite blocks.
staff.ability.tip.autumn_phantom.rush: Close a short clear gap onto one enemy; walls and unsafe flight spaces stop the rush.
staff.ability.tip.autumn_phantom.guard: Use when nearby allies are threatened, before incoming attacks become overwhelming.
staff.ability.tip.autumn_phantom.gift: Use when nearby allies need meaningful recovery; it does not heal enemies.
staff.ability.tip.autumn_phantom.gale: Save for at least three engaged enemies clustered within the leaf storm.
staff.ability.tip.autumn_phantom.crops: Aim at your approved field to gather mature crops. Harvesting pauses during combat.
staff.ability.tip.autumn_phantom.vegetat: Aim at an area you authorize for mature crops and common plants, including flowers.
staff.ability.tip.autumn_phantom.wood: Aim at the individual log you explicitly approve. She will not fell an entire structure.
staff.ability.tip.autumn_phantom.harvest: Disable further block harvesting while retaining carried resources.
codex.field.halloween_phantom.overview: A watchful pumpkin-haunted companion, equally active beneath the sun and moon. Its candlelit eyes awaken after dusk.
codex.field.halloween_phantom.spawn: Common near Pumpkins, Carved Pumpkins or Jack o'Lanterns in the Overworld throughout October, day or night. The holiday config can permit other months. Pumpkins remain intact. Never naturally found in the Deep Dark.
codex.field.halloween_phantom.defense.0: Spooky Veil briefly softens hostile attacks; major enemies resist fear effects.
codex.field.halloween_phantom.note.0: Owned companions remain loyal and fully functional all year. Daylight only changes ambient glow, not combat power.
codex.field.halloween_phantom.riding: Use your mounted ranged control for Pumpkin Gaze and mounted Fright Dive control for a safe swoop. Choose Ghostly Screech and Night of Fright through the Phantom Staff.
Briefly unsettles nearby hostile mobs with mild slowness and weakness. Each enemy has recovery time; bosses resist the disruption.
Defeat by normal damage lasts exactly forty ticks before the same companion recovers. Explicit /kill remains permanent. Ownership, Home and orders survive recovery. Bonded companions remain active all year.
A controlled orange projectile damages a hostile target and briefly disorients ordinary mobs. Use it to open an ambush or pressure an enemy beyond melee reach.
A bounded aerial swoop delivers one impact and an orange shockwave. Use against an isolated foe with a clear approach; walls and unsafe routes cancel the dive.
An orange-purple scream disrupts nearby hostile groups. Use when enemies close around you; it cannot permanently stun bosses or overwrite their AI.
A rising charge, haunted ritual, spectral pumpkin motes and three fear waves culminate in a powerful burst. Use against a clustered threat; the same ultimate cooldown applies to AI and Staff.
A reactive purple veil briefly reduces hostile incoming damage and permits a small safe evasive reposition. It has a meaningful recovery and never grants permanent invulnerability.
codex.ui.tame.independent_chance: %s%% chance per attempt; no guaranteed attempt.
phantomism.configuration.holidays.toolti: Festival months, calendar timezone and out-of-season natural spawning. Existing companions remain available all year.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.christ: Meet Christmas Phantom, the gentle winter guardian.
codex.field.christmas_phantom.overview: A warm-hearted winter guardian. Snow settles over her crimson wings, while golden light gathers where her family needs her.
codex.field.christmas_phantom.role: Defensive support / gradual recovery / festive protection
codex.field.christmas_phantom.spawn: Common in accessible snowy plains, taigas, groves and snowy slopes throughout December. The Holiday setting can permit other months. Never naturally in the Deep Dark.
codex.field.christmas_phantom.defense.0: Snowy Guard softens dangerous hostile attacks for a short time; protection cannot stack into invulnerability.
codex.field.christmas_phantom.note.0: Female. Snowballs are her only alternative taming food. The configurable chance defaults provisionally to 50% per attempt. The Phantom Staff tames instantly. Companions remain all year.
codex.field.christmas_phantom.riding: G fires Defensive Snowball; Ctrl triggers Festive Dive. Select Winter Gift, Snowy Guard and Christmas Miracle through the Phantom Staff.
Gentle periodic healing comforts nearby wounded allies. Several Christmas Phantoms cannot multiply the same aura tick.
Her December festival governs natural appearances, never ownership. Normal defeat lasts forty game ticks before the same companion recovers; explicit /kill remains permanent.
A real wrapped gift opens beside a wounded ally, releasing snow and golden healing. Use between heavy attacks to rebuild health; it never changes an inventory.
A three-dimensional enchanted snowball damages a hostile enemy and briefly slows it. Use to hold an approaching attacker at range.
A collision-safe aerial swoop delivers one snowy impact. Use against a clear, isolated threat; unsafe routes cancel the dash.
A short snow-and-gold barrier softens hostile hits. It reacts to meaningful danger and needs recovery before protecting the same ally again.
Six three-dimensional gifts orbit a festive snowflake circle and open in sequence. Healing waves culminate in a Christmas-star burst, limited cleansing and protection. Save for a wounded group.
staff.ability.tip.christmas_phantom.gift: Use when an ally needs recovery and can remain nearby while the gift opens.
staff.ability.tip.christmas_phantom.snow: Slow an approaching hostile enemy before it reaches your companions.
staff.ability.tip.christmas_phantom.dive: Choose a clear flight path onto an isolated attacker; walls stop the dive.
staff.ability.tip.christmas_phantom.guar: Protect a threatened or badly injured ally before the next heavy hit.
staff.ability.tip.christmas_phantom.mira: Save for several wounded allies gathered around her; its long recovery is shared by AI and Staff.
codex.field.easter_phantom.defense.0: Protected by the shared Holiday Spirit; recovers after two seconds. Explicit /kill remains permanent.
codex.field.easter_phantom.note.0: A graceful spring companion. Favors agile strikes, enchanted eggs and modest renewal for injured friends.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.0.des: Responsive flight and graceful turning, with brief spring trails during quick maneuvers.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.0.tip: Useful while steering through open terrain; Spring Agility works automatically.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.1.des: Celebrates the whole month containing Easter and inherits the shared Holiday recovery and ownership.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.1.tip: Use the out-of-season Holiday override to find her outside Easter's festival month.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.2.des: A controlled aerial strike followed by a short escape, or a forward mounted leap through open space.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.2.tip: Use to approach an exposed enemy, then pull away; leave clearance for the escape.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.3.des: A decorated 3D egg that bursts on impact; never hatches chickens or damages terrain.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.3.tip: Use to pressure an enemy at range or slow a pursuer without risking allies.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.4.des: Restores a modest amount of health to an injured ally and eases Slowness.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.4.tip: Use when one companion is injured; save Christmas's group protection for larger emergencies.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.5.des: A brief defensive reposition with reduced hostile damage, a safe escape route and a real cooldown.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.5.tip: Use to break away from a dangerous melee attacker; it cannot pass through walls.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.6.des: Orbiting decorated eggs radiate floral waves, harming foes and renewing nearby allies before a final blossom.
codex.field.easter_phantom.ability.6.tip: Use when several enemies threaten your nearby companions; keep allies inside the floral circle.
codex.field.easter_phantom.overview: A playful spring spirit with lavender wings, painted flowers and a gift for finding a graceful way out of danger.
codex.field.easter_phantom.spawn: Common in Plains, Sunflower Plains, Meadow, Flower Forest and Cherry Grove throughout the calendar month containing Easter. Respects the shared Holiday override.
codex.field.easter_phantom.riding: G launches Egg Burst; Ctrl performs Spring Leap. Renewal, Evasive Leap and Spring Awakening use the Phantom Staff selector.
staff.ability.tip.easter_phantom.leap: Leap through a clear opening or strike an exposed enemy, leaving room to pull away afterward.
staff.ability.tip.easter_phantom.egg: Pressure a distant attacker or slow a pursuer; the decorated egg protects your allies and terrain.
staff.ability.tip.easter_phantom.renewal: Use when one nearby companion needs a modest heal. It works best between heavy attacks.
staff.ability.tip.easter_phantom.evade: Escape a dangerous melee attacker through clear space; this cannot pass through walls or replace a retreat command.
staff.ability.tip.easter_phantom.awakeni: Save for a group fight: keep injured friends inside the floral circle while the orbiting eggs release their waves.
